lines: A Concord rifleman saw a movement across the wire.
One shot. The Hegemony sapper never got up.
Seventy-one men hit by morning. Fifty-five Hegemony, sixteen Concord.
Nine of them fell.  Their families sent the next in line.
Both hospitals are full. Every bed is taken.
Twenty-four Hegemony wounded wait on stretchers, in the mud.
And a new race has begun. Hill 304.
Hegemony ninety-seven. Concord seventy-nine. First to one hundred takes the hill.
New at the front: a letter from home.
Open your soldier's card and send one. It keeps your soldier fifteen percent safer for one night. Ten letters are already on the way.
Yesterday, 59 new soldiers came up the line. 24 Hegemony, 35 Concord.
